title: The Superemes
textContentHtml:
1. They are the ones who reached the level to understand their reality and who can travel across worlds within themselves but one at a time.

2. THE RULE OF THE WORLDS: If only one of the H's club/society is alive in the world( plus P), then that world ends to exist!

3. Hence by the rule of the worlds, all the superemes have lost their original homes and are hoping universes one at a time.
